t: This is Terza Rima, an artwork by Rebecca Salter. Salter is a British abstract artist who lives and works in London. She is best known as a painter and printmaker, and she specialises in woodblock printing, bringing together Western and Eastern traditions. She was once a ceramicist. In December 2019 she was elected the first female President of the Royal Academy of Arts, here in London. She has also written two books on Japanese woodblock prints.
